# Vendored history

`crest/` is a `git subtree` of https://github.com/Simple-With-Us/crest
(`8b4ca72` and ancestors). The directory name is left as-is so that
subtree history is not rewritten. It is not a second product.

ContactLogo is the product. Do not run the imported tree as an app.

Ported capabilities and the review-first contract are documented in
[docs/CONTACTLOGO.md](../docs/CONTACTLOGO.md).
